title: Software Engineer
description:
Company: Fraud Deflect

Role: Mid-Level — Software Engineer

Language: Native/fluent English (resumes in English)


About the role

Build and migrate backend and integration code from PHP/JavaScript into Python services. You’ll work on business logic, APIs/integrations, and data access, with light Linux operations and a strong focus on clarity, communication, and asking the right questions.


Responsibilities

  • Migrate existing PHP + JavaScript functionality into Python services (maintain behavior, improve structure, add tests).
  • Implement backend features and business logic with solid programming fundamentals.
  • Write and maintain SQL queries (data access, reporting, validations).
  • Run/debug scripts and jobs on Linux servers (SSH, logs, scheduled executions).
  • Contribute to code reviews; surface failures/risks early and propose fixes.
  • Collaborate with teammates and stakeholders: clarify requirements, ask questions, document decisions.
  • Support workflows/pipelines using Airflow or similar orchestration tools.


Required

  • Working proficiency in PHP and JavaScript and interest/ability to migrate to Python (required).
  • Strong programming logic and problem-solving skills.
  • Comfortable using Linux servers for connections and executions (SSH, basic troubleshooting).
  • SQL knowledge (able to read/write queries and understand schemas).
  • Clear communication; proactive in asking questions and calling out issues.


Nice to have

  • Airflow (or similar orchestrators like Prefect/Dagster).
  • Experience working with APIs and integrations.


How to apply

Send an English resume and links to APIs/code/docs showing Python, SQL, automation, and payments/chargebacks work.

title: Talent Pool - Persons with Disabilities (Banco de Talentos - PcD)
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


Diversity is how we build better

Diversity at Revolut drives better ideas, bolder thinking, and a more inclusive future. We’re committed to increasing representation, especially for people with disabilities who remain underrepresented in tech. That means removing barriers, opening doors, and creating access to opportunity so everyone can contribute, grow, and shape what's next in finance.


Areas we commonly hire for in Brazil


  • Audit
  • Data Analysis
  • Engineering
  • Legal
  • Risk
  • Finance
  • FinCrime
  • Operations
  • Product
  • Recruitment
  • Tax


If you don’t see your area listed above but believe your profile could be a good fit for Revolut, you’re also welcome to apply.


This is a dedicated talent track to support the inclusion of professionals with disabilities.

We move fast and we move together. Real innovation starts with representation, and we’re building a team where different abilities and perspectives are welcomed and valued.


If you apply through this channel, our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile with care. When we find a potential fit with an open role, we’ll reach out to connect you with the next steps in our hiring process.


Who can apply through this channel?

We welcome professionals with disabilities to apply through this channel or any other open roles on our careers page. This is a proactive way for us to discover diverse talent. If your profile matches an open position, our team will reach out to guide you through the next steps in the hiring process.


Can I apply if I don’t identify as a person with a disability?

This channel is specifically designed to connect with talented professionals with disabilities who want to grow their careers with Revolut. If this doesn’t describe you, please check out the range of opportunities on our careers page.


Why is Revolut breaking barriers to hire persons with disabilities in Brazil?

Our Revoluters are our priority. That’s why in 2021 we launched our D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive everyday. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Does applying here mean I’m automatically part of the recruitment process?

When you apply through this platform, our team will carefully review every profile. If your skills and experience align with a current opportunity, we’ll reach out to invite you to the next stage of our hiring process.


What if I'm not based in São Paulo? Can I still apply?

Yes. Revolut is a remote-first company that hires talent across Brazil and beyond. Our recruitment and onboarding are designed to be fully remote, and we embrace flexible work arrangements tailored to the role and business needs.


What you’ll need

  • Fluency in English
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Great problem-solving skills
  • Experience in a fast-paced working environment
  • The ability to communicate confidently across all levels
  • A self-starter attitude
  • A solid sense of ownership and ability to work independently
  • High attention to detail


Nice to have

  • Fluency in other languages
  • Practical knowledge of Google Suite


Important notice for candidates:


Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles:

  • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.


We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.


By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed, if applicable, any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn, or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed.


By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: 6 Months+ (with a possibility of extension)

Work Hours: UST Time

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Location: 100% Remote


Join our Software Asset Management (SAM) team under Enterprise Architecture and help drive license compliance, cost optimization, and effective software governance.


Key Responsibilities:

title: Analytics Architect
description:
Responsibilities:

  • Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of advanced analytics solutions using Azure Databricks/ Fabric. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of big data technologies, data engineering, and cloud computing, with a strong focus on Azure Databricks along with Strong SQL.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders and other IT teams to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
  • Oversee the end-to-end implementation of data solutions, ensuring alignment with business requirements and best practices.
  • Lead the development of data pipelines and ETL processes using Azure Databricks, PySpark, and other relevant tools.
  • Integrate Azure Databricks with other Azure services (e.g., Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory) and on-premise systems .
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the data engineering team, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
  • Ensure proper documentation of architecture, processes, and data flows, while ensuring compliance with security and governance standards.
  • Ensure best practices are followed in terms of code quality, data security, and scalability.
  • Stay updated with the latest developments in Databricks and associated technologies to drive innovation.


Essential Skills:

  • Strong experience with Azure Databricks , including cluster management, notebook development, and Delta Lake.
  • Proficiency in big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark) and data processing frameworks (e.g., PySpark).
  • Deep understanding of Azure services like Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, and Azure Data Factory. Power BI, SSRS, SSAS, PSKU to F SKU.
  • Experience with ETL/ELT processes, data warehousing, and building data lakes.
  • Strong SQL skills and familiarity with NoSQL databases.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems like Git.
  • Knowledge of cloud security best practices.


Soft Skills:

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.
  • Leadership skills with the ability to manage and mentor a team of data engineers.


Nice to have Skills:

  • Power BI for dashboarding and reporting.
  • Microsoft Fabric for analytics and integration tasks.
  • Spark Streaming for processing real-time data streams.
  • Familiarity with Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates for infrastructure as code (IaC) practices.


Experience:

1. Demonstrated expertise of 12+ years in developing data ingestion and transformation pipelines using Databricks/Synapse notebooks and Azure Data Factory.

2. Solid understanding and hands-on experience with Delta tables, Delta Lake, and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2.

3. Experience in efficiently using Auto Loader and Delta Live tables for seamless data ingestion and transformation.

4. Proficiency in building and optimizing query layers using Databricks SQL.

5. Demonstrated experience integrating Databricks with Azure Synapse, ADLS Gen2, and Power BI for end-to-end analytics solutions.

6. Prior experience in developing, optimizing, and deploying Power BI reports.

7. Familiarity with modern CI/CD practices, especially in the context of Databricks and cloud-native solutions.

title: U.S. Immigration Paralegal/Case Manager
description:
Company Description


Robinson Immigration Law is a boutique U.S. immigration law firm based in Nashville, Tennessee, serving clients across the United States and globally with 100% remote capability. The firm focuses on high-skill, business, and investment-based immigration, working with founders, executives, researchers, creatives, and investors looking to build their lives and careers in the U.S. With expertise in pathways such as EB-1A, EB-2 NIW, O-1A, and E-2, Robinson Immigration Law prioritizes thoughtful positioning and effective solutions to achieve durable immigration outcomes.


Role Description


This is a full-time, remote role for an Immigration Case Manager (Paralegal), with a focus on visas including the EB-1A, EB-2 NIW, O-1, and E-2.


The case manager will assist in immigration case preparation, including conducting legal research, drafting support letters, and completing immigration forms. Responsibilities include communicating with clients to gather necessary documents, providing updates on case status, and maintaining accurate and organized electronic filing systems. The role also involves calendaring deadlines, ensuring timely submissions, and collaborating directly with attorneys to ensure a smooth and efficient case process.


Qualifications


  • Strong legal research, case management, and document preparation skills
  • Experience in drafting professional correspondence and support letters
  • Excellent organizational, time management, and attention-to-detail capabilities
  • Well-developed communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to interact professionally with clients
  • Proficiency in legal or office software systems and tools
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment and manage multiple tasks or deadlines
  • Prior experience in immigration law, particularly with employment-based or investment-based visa processes, is highly preferred


We offer a supportive and collaborative team environment, competitive salary and vacation, and opportunities for learning and advancement.


We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Remote Biomedical Informatics SME - 58854
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are seeking highly skilled Biomedical Informatics Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to join our team in developing rigorous, high-quality evaluation questions designed to assess and challenge advanced AI models. The primary objective is to create benchmark questions that test the boundaries of AI capabilities across diverse bioinformatics domains.

This role requires deep technical expertise combined with the ability to craft precise, unambiguous questions with well-defined evaluations. The ideal candidate will possess not only strong theoretical knowledge but also practical experience in designing assessment materials that have deterministic, verifiable outcomes.


Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop challenging bioinformatics coding questions that push the limits of AI model capabilities.
  • Create automated, coding-based evaluations with unit tests that objectively verify correctness.
  • Build comprehensive evaluation rubrics with 7–10 distinct criteria for each bioinformatics question.
  • Ensure every question is self-contained, well-defined, and completely unambiguous, including all domain rules and edge cases.
  • Develop problems where there is exactly one correct answer or outcome that can be deterministically validated.
  • Translate theoretical bioinformatics concepts into concrete, measurable outputs.
  • Enforce performance requirements with explicit constraints and tests to prevent inefficient or brute-force solutions.


Required Qualifications:

Educational Background

  • Master's degree of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • Ongoing PhD with 3+ years of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • PhD (completed) in Biomedical Informatics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology or a closely related field (preferred).


Technical and other skills

  • Strong proficiency in biomedical data processing, analysis, and interpretation , including working with large‑scale datasets.
  • Experience with bioinformatics tools and pipelines (e.g., NGS workflows, multi‑omics, etc.).
  • Solid programming skills in Python / R
  • Experience working in Linux/Unix , Docker and version control.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills for working in interdisciplinary research teams


Domain Expertise Requirements

Candidates must demonstrate deep, expert-level knowledge in at least TWO (2) of the following five core bioinformatics domains:

1. Biomedical Image Processing

  • Processing of Radiology imaging: CT, MRI, PET/SPECT, Ultrasound imaging
  • Automating cell counting, identifying cell types, and analyzing tissue structures in pathology slides
  • Computational segmentation and boundary inference
  • Medical image formation, reconstruction & enhancement
  • Noise modeling and statistical denoising
  • Image sampling theory and resolution limits
  • Intensity standardization and harmonization
  • Geometric transformations and spatial calibration
  • Multi-modal image registration and alignment
  • Morphological and topological shape analysis
  • Quantitative imaging feature extraction
  • Fusing data from different modalities (MRI, PET, Genomics) for a comprehensive view to tailor treatments
  • pattern recognition and predictive modeling

2. Biomedical Signal Processing

  • Cardiovascular/hemodynamic signals (ECG, PPG, BP, HRV, etc)
  • Neural/brain electrical signals (EEG, EP/ERP; seizure/cognitive analysis)
  • Neuromuscular/motor signals (EMG, motor unit decomposition; prosthetics/rehab)
  • Ocular/visual system signals (EOG, blink/saccade analysis)
  • Respiratory signals (airflow, effort; sleep/disordered breathing)
  • Nonlinear, Statistical, and Adaptive Signal Analysis
  • Multichannel, Spatial, and Connectivity Signal Analysis
  • Machine Learning and Data‑Driven Biomedical Signal Analysis
  • Clinical Monitoring, Wearable, and Translational Signal Processing

3. Molecular & Omics based Personalized Medicine

  • Omics based risk / disease prediction (GWAS, PRS, bulk, single‑cell RNA‑seq, proteins / metabolite signatures associated with diseases)
  • Risk Prediction and Prognosis Modeling
  • Molecular patient subtyping
  • Liquid Biopsy and Circulating Biomarkers (ctDNA, cfRNA/miRNA, MRD, etc.)
  • Causal Inference & Mechanistic Inference (ATE/CATE, Trial emulation and counterfactual modeling)
  • Cross‑modal data fusion (omics + EHR + imaging / signals)
  • Longitudinal Patient Modeling and Disease Progression
  • Patient Stratification and Subtyping (molecular subtypes, endotypes)
  • Electronic Health Records and Clinical Data Science

4. Drug Discovery & Repurposing

  • Treatment response prediction
  • Structure-based drug design (Molecular docking, binding site analysis, Virtual screening workflow)
  • Protein structure analysis (PDB/mmCIF handling)
  • Chemoinformatics ( Ligand-based screening, molecular fingerprinting, 2D/3D data handling and chemical space analysis)
  • QSAR & ADMET Modeling
  • Drug–target interaction prediction
  • Drug sensitivity prediction in disease models
  • Repurposing via omics/network associations
  • Predictive Modeling for Drug Discovery Molecular Dynamics Simulation of Biomolecules (QM, DFT, stability, reactivity, PCA analysis )

5. Software / Utilities

  • Tool installation & environment management (docker/conda/pip)
  • Format conversion/validation (FASTA/FASTQ, BAM/VCF, PDB)
  • GUI-driven analysis workflows (step-by-step runs)
  • Workflow automation (scripts wrapping GUI tools)
  • Visualization tools (genome browsers, 3D viewers)
  • Container/VM execution and troubleshooting
  • Batch processing and report generation
  • Pipeline interoperability checks
  • Reproducibility packaging (configs, manifests)
  • Debugging typical bioinformatics tool errors

6. Regulatory Science and Clinical Policies

  • FDA/EMA regulatory pathways
  • Clinical Practice Guidelines & Standards of Care (e.g., NCCN, AHA, etc.)
  • Diagnostic Biomarker & Therapeutic Use Constraints
  • Medical Scenario Reasoning (case vignettes, Differential diagnosis)
  • Data & Content Compliance
  • Ethical Use, Safety, and Harm Prevention
  • Model Use Governance & Auditability
  • Policy‑Aligned Language & Communication
  • Clinical validation and cohort generalization
  • Privacy‑preserving learning


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : At least 30 hours per week. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 2 months; (expected start date is next week)


Evaluation Process:

  • Take home Assessment on Biomedical Informatics (2-6 hours)
  • Delivery discussion(15-30mins)


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer (Python & AI/ML) – Full-Time, Remote
description:
Senior Software Engineer (Python & AI/ML)


Company: GTG LLC

Company Stage: Startup / Growth-Stage

Location: Remote

Experience Level: Senior (7+ years)


About the Role


GTG LLC is a growing startup building intelligent, scalable software solutions. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with deep expertise in Python and AI/ML engineering, who is also comfortable operating across the full stack.


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys ownership, moving fast, and solving complex technical problems in an early-stage environment. You will work closely with founders and key stakeholders to design, build, and scale backend systems, AI-driven services, and modern web applications.


Key Responsibilities


 - Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Python and frameworks such as Flask, Django, and FastAPI

 - Build and integrate AI/ML solutions, including model deployment, inference pipelines, and data processing workflows

 - Architect and maintain RESTful APIs with strong performance, scalability, and reliability

 - Collaborate on frontend development using modern JavaScript frameworks such as React, Next.js, Angular, or Vue

 - Contribute to overall system architecture, technical decisions, and engineering best practices

 - Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines to ensure reliable deployments and high code quality

 - Work across the full product lifecycle, from early design and prototyping to production support

 - Identify technical gaps and proactively propose and implement solutions


Required Qualifications


 - 7+ years of professional experience as a Software Engineer or similar senior-level role

 - C1 or higher English proficiency (mandatory) — strong verbal and written communication skills

 - Deep expertise in Python and backend development

 - Hands-on experience with Flask, Django, and/or FastAPI

 - Strong background in AI/ML engineering, including production-level model integration and deployment

 - Proficiency with modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Next.js, Angular, or Vue)

 - Cloud experience with AWS or Azure (required)

 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, version control, and production deployment workflows

 - Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast-paced startup environment


Nice to Have


 - Experience with Java or C#, or proficiency in more than one backend programming language

 - Experience with GCP in addition to AWS or Azure

 - Prior experience working in early-stage or fast-moving startups


What We Offer


 - Opportunity to play a key technical role in a growing startup

 - High level of ownership and influence over architecture and product direction

 - Fully remote and flexible work environment

 - Competitive compensation, based on experience and skill level

title: Analista de implementação Bitrix24
description:
(IMPORTANTE: Já ter atuado com Bitrix24 e n8n são requisítos mínimos.)


Somos uma empresa pioneira em soluções tecnológicas que combinam implementações Bitrix24 com inteligência artificial avançada. Estamos na vanguarda da criação de agentes de IA e automações inteligentes que revolucionam processos empresariais. Nosso diferencial está no desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas potencializadas por IA que transformam radicalmente a operação de nossos clientes, oferecendo eficiência e inovação através da combinação de Bitrix24, n8n e modelos avançados de linguagem (LLMs).


A Oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um talento que irá atuar majoritariamente em nossas implementações Bitrix24 e o auxiliar nos desenvolvimento soluções de IA, contribuindo diretamente para o crescimento da empresa em um momento crucial de expansão. Esta é sua chance de fazer parte de uma equipe inovadora que está na fronteira da tecnologia, criando agentes de IA personalizados e redefinindo o uso de ferramentas empresariais com inteligência artificial avançada.


Suas Responsabilidades:

Implementações Bitrix24 de Excelência

- Trabalhar diretamente com nossos clientes nas implementações Bitrix24

- Participar ativamente de calls para entendimento de projetos e requisitos

- Manter comunicação constante com os clientes durante todo o ciclo de implementação

- Desenvolver automações customizadas que transformam processos empresariais

- Realizar configurações e customizações avançadas na plataforma

- Fornecer suporte técnico especializado, garantindo a satisfação contínua dos clientes


Integrações Avançadas com n8n

- Criar fluxos de integração perfeitos entre sistemas de terceiros e o Bitrix24

- Utilizar o n8n como ferramenta principal para construção de integrações robustas

- Otimizar processos através de integrações entre múltiplas plataformas

- Possuir domínio da ferramenta para conseguir analisar e interpretar workflows já existentes


Será um diferencial se você:

- Construir agentes de IA inovadores utilizando LLMs através do n8n

- Desenvolver, testar e refinar prompts para aplicações de IA

- Implementar soluções de inteligência artificial que tragam resultados mensuráveis para nossos clientes


Crescimento Real

- Oportunidade de crescimento em uma empresa em expansão

- Potencial para assumir posições de liderança à medida que crescemos

- Participação ativa nas decisões estratégicas da empresa


Perfil Que Buscamos

Procuramos alguém que vista a camisa da empresa e tenha verdadeira \"dor de dono\". Como parte de um time enxuto e altamente colaborativo, você terá a oportunidade de participar ativamente de todas as atividades da empresa, contribuindo em múltiplas frentes e desenvolvendo uma visão completa do negócio.

Valorizamos profissionais com excelente comunicação e habilidade para construir relacionamentos de confiança com os clientes. Você atuará como o principal ponto de contato técnico, representando nossa empresa em reuniões, calls de alinhamento e apresentações de soluções, sendo fundamental sua capacidade de entender as necessidades dos clientes e transformá-las em implementações eficientes.


Faça Parte da Nossa História

Esta não é apenas uma vaga de trabalho – é uma oportunidade de fazer parte de algo especial desde o início. Se você é apaixonado por tecnologia, tem experiência com Bitrix24, n8n e está animado com as possibilidades da IA, queremos conhecer você!

title: MS D365 CRM Functional Consultant
description:
We never request payment at any stage of our recruitment process, and we only contact candidates through official corporate accounts and platforms. If you are approached with any request for payment, it is likely fraudulent. Please verify whether the role you are interested in is posted on our official website.



About TMF Group

TMF Group is a leading global provider of high-value business services to clients operating and investing worldwide. We deliver specialized, business‑critical financial and administrative services that enable our clients to operate their corporate structures, finance vehicles and investment funds across multiple jurisdictions.



Discover the Role

We are seeking a CRM Business Analyst / CRM Functional Consultant who will play a key role in gathering business requirements and supporting implementations of Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) . The ideal candidate is resourceful, detail‑oriented, self‑driven and committed to deeply understanding business needs and translating them into effective technical solutions.

Strong listening skills, collaboration, openness to feedback and a sense of ownership are essential to success in this role. If you are driven by challenge, enjoy going the extra mile and want to work with highly talented professionals, this is the opportunity for you.

If you are an experienced Microsoft D365 CRM Functional Consultant seeking dynamic projects and a collaborative team, we encourage you to apply.



Key Responsibilities

  • Gather and document business requirements in collaboration with stakeholders.
  • Implement Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions tailored to business needs.
  • Configure and customize D365 CRM to meet functional requirements.
  • Work closely with technical teams to integrate CRM with other systems.
  • Participate in project planning, estimating and project management activities.
  • Deliver end‑user training and provide ongoing functional support.
  • Maintain up‑to‑date knowledge of new D365 CRM features and capabilities.
  • Mentor and guide junior consultants when needed.


Key Requirements

  • Experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM implementation and customization.
  • Experience with version 8.0 or later.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Experience developing custom workflows, entities and plugins using C# or .NET .
  • Strong understanding of D365 CRM’s data model, security model and configuration options.
  • Excellent analytical, problem‑solving and critical‑thinking skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently or in a team environment.



What’s in It for You?

Career Development

  • Opportunities for internal mobility and career progression.
  • Collaboration with global colleagues and exposure to international clients.
  • Continuous learning supported by the TMF Business Academy.

Making an Impact

  • Direct contribution to simplifying global business operations for our clients.
  • Opportunities to support local communities through our corporate social responsibility initiatives.

A Supportive Environment

  • A strong feedback culture that supports growth and engagement.
  • Flexibility to work from our offices or remotely, promoting work‑life balance.
  • An inclusive environment where people are empowered and encouraged to grow their careers.

At TMF Group, our people define who we are . We thrive on entrepreneurial spirit and value proactive professionals who bring passion, accountability and excellence to everything they do.

  • Conhecimento no mercado agrícola, culturas e produtividade, cálculos de equivalência (sacas), avaliação de risco, noções de crédito e compliance.

description:
Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:


  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?


Como .NET Developer na Builders você irá atuar no desenvolvimento de plataforma, produzindo e otimizando códigos para maior performance, escalabilidade e velocidade. Será responsável pela qualidade e funcionalidade das soluções implementadas.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:


  • Plataforma .NET Core (C#): Sólido conhecimento no desenvolvimento de aplicações utilizando .NET Core.
  • Angular: Experiência prática no desenvolvimento de interfaces com o framework Angular.
  • APIs Web (WebApi): Domínio na criação, consumo e manutenção de APIs RESTful.
  • Bancos de Dados: Conhecimento em bancos relacionais e não relacionais, como SQL Server, MongoDB e Oracle.
  • Testes Automatizados: Experiência na criação de testes de unidade e de integração utilizando ferramentas como xUnit, Moq ou NSubstitute.
  • Controle de Versão: Familiaridade com Git para versionamento de código.
  • Arquitetura de Software e Padrões de Projeto: Conhecimento em DDD (Domain-Driven Design), Design Patterns, arquitetura orientada a eventos (Event-Driven Architecture), microsserviços e práticas de integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD).
  • Boas Práticas de Desenvolvimento: Aplicação de princípios como Clean Code, SOLID, DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself), KISS (Keep It Simple, Stupid) e YAGNI (You Aren’t Gonna Need It).
  • Containers: Conhecimento em Docker para criação e gerenciamento de ambientes isolados.


Será um diferencial se você tiver também:


  • Conhecimento em tecnologias legadas para projetos de migração: Socket, SOAP;
  • Familiaridade com Práticas Ágeis;
  • Mensageria (RabbitMq, Azure Service Bus).


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;

title: Desenvolvedor(a) .Net + Angular Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:


  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?


Como .NET Developer na Builders você irá atuar no desenvolvimento de plataforma, produzindo e otimizando códigos para maior performance, escalabilidade e velocidade. Será responsável pela qualidade e funcionalidade das soluções implementadas.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:


  • Plataforma .NET Core (C#): Sólido conhecimento no desenvolvimento de aplicações utilizando .NET Core.
  • Angular: Experiência prática no desenvolvimento de interfaces com o framework Angular.
  • APIs Web (WebApi): Domínio na criação, consumo e manutenção de APIs RESTful.
  • Bancos de Dados: Conhecimento em bancos relacionais e não relacionais, como SQL Server, MongoDB e Oracle.
  • Testes Automatizados: Experiência na criação de testes de unidade e de integração utilizando ferramentas como xUnit, Moq ou NSubstitute.
  • Controle de Versão: Familiaridade com Git para versionamento de código.
  • Arquitetura de Software e Padrões de Projeto: Conhecimento em DDD (Domain-Driven Design), Design Patterns, arquitetura orientada a eventos (Event-Driven Architecture), microsserviços e práticas de integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD).
  • Boas Práticas de Desenvolvimento: Aplicação de princípios como Clean Code, SOLID, DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself), KISS (Keep It Simple, Stupid) e YAGNI (You Aren’t Gonna Need It).
  • Containers: Conhecimento em Docker para criação e gerenciamento de ambientes isolados.


Será um diferencial se você tiver também:


  • Conhecimento em tecnologias legadas para projetos de migração: Socket, SOAP;
  • Familiaridade com Práticas Ágeis;
  • Mensageria (RabbitMq, Azure Service Bus).

title: Lead Java Developer - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • More than 10 years as a Back-End Developer with Java;
  • Experience with the latest versions of Java;
  • Solid experience with Spring Boot, Terraform, Kubernetes, Kafka, GraphQL and GitHub;
  • Work experience with Microsoft Cloud Azure;
  • Experience with leading complex initiatives and the collaboration with other teams to agree technical designs - Mandatory ;
  • Experience with Coaching and mentoring more junior engineers, influencing and improving the engineering practices within a team;
  • Fluency in English (B2+) - Mandatory ;
  • Willing to move to Portugal with our support.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;

  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;

Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

description:
About Monee

At Monee, we believe that every team member is essential to our success — and that diversity of perspectives and experiences is key to driving our business and advancing our purpose of changing the world for the better.

Being part of our team means growing within a fast-paced and agile culture. If you love taking on big responsibilities and doing what has never been done before, Monee is the place for you.

Here, you’ll face meaningful challenges, collaborate with a diverse team, and help shape the future of the fintech industry in Brazil — creating a positive impact in the lives of millions.

We adopt a hybrid work model, this model allows people to adjust their work environment according to their personal needs, while promoting collaboration and interaction in the office.

Planning and execution of projects related to credit products, including participation in and development of initiatives focused on identifying business opportunities, conducting in-depth analyses, and implementing new solutions. Creation of strategic initiatives aimed at driving growth and cost reduction. Leadership of workstreams within high-impact projects in a fast-paced environment, ensuring concrete and tangible deliverables. Ongoing interaction with teams across different areas and countries, as well as direct collaboration with multiple internal stakeholders and external partners.

  • Own and deliver strategic and tactical initiatives to drive growth and cost reduction;

  • Interact with teams from different areas and countries. Work closely with the SG SeaMoney team.

What you need to take on the challenge:

  • Experience in Credit Products for Consumers (BNPL, Personal Loan, Secured Credit etc.)
  • Advanced English (speaking, reading, and writing is mandatory);
  • Hands-on profile, ability to think strategically;
  • Data-drive profile, being capable of dealing with complex models and analysis;
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with cross-functional teams and external

stakeholders;

  • Medical and dental care, extended to dependents;
  • Partnership with Gympass and TotalPass;
  • Flexible meal/food vouchers;
  • Transportation vouchers, mobility vouchers or on-site parking;
  • Flexible benefits;
  • Zenklub;
  • Discretionary annual bonus, linked to performance.

title: MS D365 CRM Functional Consultant
description:
We never request payment at any stage of our recruitment process, and we only contact candidates through official corporate accounts and platforms. If you are approached with any request for payment, it is likely fraudulent. Please verify whether the role you are interested in is posted on our official website.



About TMF Group

TMF Group is a leading global provider of high-value business services to clients operating and investing worldwide. We deliver specialized, business‑critical financial and administrative services that enable our clients to operate their corporate structures, finance vehicles and investment funds across multiple jurisdictions.



Discover the Role

We are seeking a CRM Business Analyst / CRM Functional Consultant who will play a key role in gathering business requirements and supporting implementations of Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) . The ideal candidate is resourceful, detail‑oriented, self‑driven and committed to deeply understanding business needs and translating them into effective technical solutions.

Strong listening skills, collaboration, openness to feedback and a sense of ownership are essential to success in this role. If you are driven by challenge, enjoy going the extra mile and want to work with highly talented professionals, this is the opportunity for you.

If you are an experienced Microsoft D365 CRM Functional Consultant seeking dynamic projects and a collaborative team, we encourage you to apply.



Key Responsibilities

  • Gather and document business requirements in collaboration with stakeholders.
  • Implement Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions tailored to business needs.
  • Configure and customize D365 CRM to meet functional requirements.
  • Work closely with technical teams to integrate CRM with other systems.
  • Participate in project planning, estimating and project management activities.
  • Deliver end‑user training and provide ongoing functional support.
  • Maintain up‑to‑date knowledge of new D365 CRM features and capabilities.
  • Mentor and guide junior consultants when needed.


Key Requirements

  • Experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM implementation and customization.
  • Experience with version 8.0 or later.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Experience developing custom workflows, entities and plugins using C# or .NET .
  • Strong understanding of D365 CRM’s data model, security model and configuration options.
  • Excellent analytical, problem‑solving and critical‑thinking skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently or in a team environment.



What’s in It for You?

Career Development

  • Opportunities for internal mobility and career progression.
  • Collaboration with global colleagues and exposure to international clients.
  • Continuous learning supported by the TMF Business Academy.

Making an Impact

  • Direct contribution to simplifying global business operations for our clients.
  • Opportunities to support local communities through our corporate social responsibility initiatives.

A Supportive Environment

  • A strong feedback culture that supports growth and engagement.
  • Flexibility to work from our offices or remotely, promoting work‑life balance.
  • An inclusive environment where people are empowered and encouraged to grow their careers.

At TMF Group, our people define who we are . We thrive on entrepreneurial spirit and value proactive professionals who bring passion, accountability and excellence to everything they do.

  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?


Como .NET Developer na Builders você irá atuar no desenvolvimento de plataforma, produzindo e otimizando códigos para maior performance, escalabilidade e velocidade. Será responsável pela qualidade e funcionalidade das soluções implementadas.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:


  • Plataforma .NET Core (C#): Sólido conhecimento no desenvolvimento de aplicações utilizando .NET Core.
  • Angular: Experiência prática no desenvolvimento de interfaces com o framework Angular.
  • APIs Web (WebApi): Domínio na criação, consumo e manutenção de APIs RESTful.
  • Bancos de Dados: Conhecimento em bancos relacionais e não relacionais, como SQL Server, MongoDB e Oracle.
  • Testes Automatizados: Experiência na criação de testes de unidade e de integração utilizando ferramentas como xUnit, Moq ou NSubstitute.
  • Controle de Versão: Familiaridade com Git para versionamento de código.
  • Arquitetura de Software e Padrões de Projeto: Conhecimento em DDD (Domain-Driven Design), Design Patterns, arquitetura orientada a eventos (Event-Driven Architecture), microsserviços e práticas de integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD).
  • Boas Práticas de Desenvolvimento: Aplicação de princípios como Clean Code, SOLID, DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself), KISS (Keep It Simple, Stupid) e YAGNI (You Aren’t Gonna Need It).
  • Containers: Conhecimento em Docker para criação e gerenciamento de ambientes isolados.


Será um diferencial se você tiver também:


  • Conhecimento em tecnologias legadas para projetos de migração: Socket, SOAP;
  • Familiaridade com Práticas Ágeis;
  • Mensageria (RabbitMq, Azure Service Bus).


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

title: Gerente de Projetos
description:
Responsabilidades

  • Assegurar que todas as atividades e operações sejam realizadas de forma segura, em conformidade com os regulamentos e a legislação que regem as operações de negócios.
  • Identificar escopo, premissas, restrições e requisitos técnicos do projeto.
  • Elaborar o plano do projeto, garantindo integração entre escopo, custos, receita, recursos e prazos.
  • Identificar e analisar quantitativa e qualitativamente os riscos do projeto, criando planos de respostas e realizando também seu monitoramento.
  • Controlar mudanças e seus impactos.
  • Conduzir reuniões/apresentações sobre o projeto com clientes e equipe.
  • Coletar, distribuir e aplicar lições aprendidas.
  • Desenvolver relacionamento com o cliente identificando oportunidades.
  • Aplicar as diretrizes de gerenciamento de projetos.
  • Gerenciar o contrato e garantir que as ações estejam alinhadas com as questões contratuais, incluindo licenças, seguros, garantias bancárias e faturas aos clientes.
  • Realizar controle financeiro, realizado e forecast, para custos e receitas.
  • Garantir o faturamento e recebimento prontamente conforme contrato.
  • Liderar e motivar a equipe do projeto com o objetivo de atingir a produtividade ideal contribuindo para o sucesso do projeto.
  • Participar ativamente e promover melhorias no sistema de QSSMS da
  • empresa.
  • Realizar visitas às frentes operacionais, exercendo seu papel de liderança visível.
  • Garantir a eficiência na execução do projeto de acordo com o requerimento contratual (escopo, cronograma e custo/receita).
  • Garantir a comunicação eficiente entre os envolvidos (cliente, fornecedor, parceiro, áreas de suporte, operação).
  • Gerenciar riscos, resolver problemas utilizando ferramentas de gestão de projetos e melhoria contínua.

Requisitos

  • Graduação em Engenharia Civil, Engenharia de Controle e Automação ou afins.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens e eventuais permanências em projeto.
  • Ampla vivência e experiência em gestão de projetos de médio/grande porte.
  • Pós-graduação em Gerenciamento de Projetos.
  • MS-Project Avançado.
  • Pacote office avançado (Principalmente Excel).

Desejável/Diferencial

  • Certificação Green Belt, PMI ou APM será diferencial.
  • Inglês intermediário será diferencial.

Local de Trabalho

  • Belo Horizonte/MG
  • Jornada Híbrida

title: Especialista de Barter
description:
RAINBOW DEFENSIVOS AGRÍCOLAS

Tudo sobre crescimento.



Somos uma empresa líder em proteção de cultivos que produz, distribui e comercializa Defensivos Agrícolas.

Somos a maior exportadora de agroquímicos da China e TOP10 indústria agroquímica global, presente em mais de 100 países nos 5 continentes, com 6 fábricas próprias e um time de especialistas focados em solucionar as necessidades dos clientes.


Estamos em expansão no Brasil e buscamos profissionais comprometidos e que enxerguem na expansão uma oportunidade de construir e transformar.


Se você quer atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e contribuir para transformar o futuro da proteção de cultivos no país, venha fazer parte da Rainbow Defensivos Agrícolas.


  • Especialista de Barter


PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES:


  • Construir e manter relacionamento próximo com tradings e demais parceiros de Barter, garantindo alternativas competitivas de originação;
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time de Marketing para desenvolver ofertas e campanhas de Barter alinhadas à estratégia comercial;
  • Apoiar diretamente o time comercial na execução das operações, desde a negociação até o fechamento do deal;
  • Analisar propostas, validar cálculos, condições, lastro agrícola e exposição de risco;
  • Garantir a acuracidade, integridade e arquivamento correto de todos os documentos (CPRs, contratos, termos, cessões, garantias etc.);
  • Monitorar o fluxo das operações no SAP, assegurando compliance com processos internos e SLAs;
  • Acompanhar o pós-negócio, garantindo aderência ao calendário de liquidação do Barter e Apoiar treinamentos internos e disseminação de conhecimento sobre Barter para o time comercial.



REQUISITOS:


  • Graduação em Agronomia, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Atuação prévia com operações de Barter, relacionamento com tradings, análise de CPRs e documentação contratual.
  • Conhecimento no mercado agrícola, culturas e produtividade, cálculos de equivalência (sacas), avaliação de risco, noções de crédito e compliance.
  • SAP e pacote Office (Excel avançado desejável).


DESEJÁVEL:

  • MBA/Pós em Agronegócio, Finanças ou Mercado de Commodities.
  • Inglês intermediário

title: Lead Java Developer - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • More than 10 years as a Back-End Developer with Java;
  • Experience with the latest versions of Java;
  • Solid experience with Spring Boot, Terraform, Kubernetes, Kafka, GraphQL and GitHub;
  • Work experience with Microsoft Cloud Azure;
  • Experience with leading complex initiatives and the collaboration with other teams to agree technical designs - Mandatory ;
  • Experience with Coaching and mentoring more junior engineers, influencing and improving the engineering practices within a team;
  • Fluency in English (B2+) - Mandatory ;
  • Willing to move to Portugal with our support.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
About the role

Netcracker Technology is looking to hire an Senior IT Security Engineer to be part of our Global Security Team, in this position, you will be responsible for the discovery, analysis and support of Netcracker's internal and external Security processes and tools.


Role & Responsibilities

  • Support Security Infrastructure – patching, upgrades, platform expansions
  • Support SOP (Standard Operating Procedures)
  • Support Security Applications – SIEM, EDR, HSM, 2FA, DLP, FTK, etc
  • Perform in an on-call rotation – for after-hours issues/maintenance as needed
  • Create internal/customer facing documentation, including procedures, solution, architecture diagrams
  • Support audit initiatives, providing auditors with the requested information/artifacts, etc
  • Support vulnerability management - analyzing vulnerabilities, performing the remediation actions
  • Deploy, configure, and manage security applications in alignment with industry best practices
  • Collaborating with IT and application teams to integrate security controls
  • Automate security processes and tool integrations using scripting and orchestration platforms
  • Support initiatives to strengthen Netcracker’s security posture
  • Conduct vendor due diligence research, POV’s, and POC’s


Required Experience

  • Technical experience with Linux, UNIX
  • Knowledgeable in IT processes, security concepts and industry best practices
  • Ability to create clearly written documentation of processes
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • 3+ years of security engineering, systems administration, or relevant technical experience
  • Experience working at a mid or large size enterprise IT environment, a plus
  • Experience with 2FA, DLP, SIEM, HSM, PAM, PKI, EDR, NDR, IAM, ITAM a plus
  • Experience with VMware, ESXi, Hyper-V, SCVMM a plus
  • Knowledge of networking a plus
  • IT/Security related certification, such as Security+, Security X, SSCP, CISSP desirable
  • Fluent English speaker


Education

  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems or related major, or equivalent

title: Farmacotécnico Sr (Foco em VET)
description:
Venha fazer parte da Nação Azul!


Como será o seu dia a dia :


Avaliar e propor qualitativamente e quantitativamente os componentes das fórmulas de novos produtos, bem como dos processos de fabricação e compreender os resultados analíticos;


Realizar consultas em literaturas referentes aos componentes da formulação, técnicas sobre o processo de fabricação da forma farmacêutica definida, bem como das diretrizes regulatórias;


Orientar os pares de trabalho em relação a sequência de atividades de desenvolvimento dos novos produtos, de acordo com o preconizado na legislação vigente;


Orientar os pares de trabalho na elaboração e revisão das documentações técnicas referentes ao processo de desenvolvimento de um novo produto, como relatórios de desenvolvimento da formulação e processo, relatório de produção, relatório de acompanhamento de produto, documentação para regulatório, etc., através dos resultados dos testes de bancada, semi-industrial ou industrial;


Elaborar ou modificar, junto a coordenação, a documentação para fabricação dos lotes de bancada, as instruções de fabricação (IF) dos lotes semi-industrial, assim como lista técnica e receita mestre, de acordo com a fórmula e processos definidos, a fim de obter o produto final desejado de forma padronizada;


Manipular os lotes de bancada em laboratório conforme fórmula e processo propostos e de acordo com as normas de Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF) e Boas Práticas de Laboratório (BPL);


Acompanhar todas as etapas do processo de fabricação do lote piloto semi-industrial ou lotes para venda, quando necessário, orientando os operadores quanto aos parâmetros e dúvidas em geral, a fim de garantir que o lote seja produzido com a técnica correta e adequado ao estudo de estabilidade, pesquisa clínica ou liberação para comercialização (quando aplicável);


Acompanhar os processos produtivos realizados em terceiros, utilizando ferramentas para elaboração de relatórios, visando realizar a internalização do processo dentro da empresa, quando possível;


Executar o preenchimento das planilhas de viabilidades econômicas solicitadas pelo setor de Novos Negócios.


Para fazer acontecer, você precisa (Mandatórios) :


Superior Completo em Farmácia.


Será Considerado como Diferencial:


Conhecimento em legislação do MAPA;

Conhecimento em equipamentos de laboratório e escala piloto;

Desenvolvimento em Medicamentos/Suplementos de uso Veterinário nas formas farmacêuticas sólidas, líquidas e semi-sólidos.

title: Assessor de investimentos
description:
Descrição da Empresa ACI Capital AI é um escritório credenciado à EQI Investimentos. A EQI Investimentos é uma corretora de valores brasileira, tem o BTG como Socio, atua no mercado financeiro oferecendo serviços e soluções de investimento para clientes pessoa física e jurídica. A empresa possui autorização do Banco Central do Brasil e é regulada pela CVM (Comissão de Valores Mobiliários) e pela B3 , garantindo funcionamento dentro das normas do mercado de capitais brasileiro.

A EQI disponibiliza uma plataforma de investimentos e uma carteira de mais de 1.000 produtos financeiros , incluindo:

  • Ações e renda variável
  • Renda fixa (CDBs, LCIs/LCAs, debêntures etc.)
  • Fundos de investimento
  • ETFs
  • Criptoativos
  • Ofertas públicas e alternativas de investimento.

A EQI combina tecnologia com assessoria personalizada , buscando atender diferentes perfis de investidor — desde iniciantes até mais experientes — por meio de suporte direto de assessores e uma experiência de atendimento próximo ao cliente.

Hoje a empresa mantém escritórios em várias cidades do Brasil , somando dezenas de milhares de clientes e dezenas de bilhões de reais sob custódia.

A EQI se posiciona como uma corretora moderna e orientada à autonomia do investidor , com foco em educação financeira, transparência e soluções de investimento alinhadas aos objetivos de longo prazo dos seus clientes.


Descrição do Cargo. O Assessor de Investimentos é o profissional responsável por orientar clientes na tomada de decisões financeiras , oferecendo soluções de investimento alinhadas ao perfil, objetivos e horizonte de tempo de cada investidor. Atua como elo entre o cliente e o mercado financeiro, acompanhando a carteira, sugerindo ajustes e promovendo educação financeira contínua.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Realizar atendimento de acordo com perfil do investidor (Suitability)
  • Indicar produtos financeiros como renda fixa, ações, fundos, ETFs e investimentos alternativos
  • Acompanhar as carteiras de investimento periodicamente
  • Prospectar e fidelizar clientes
  • Esclarecer riscos, oportunidades e cenários econômicos
  • Manter relacionamento próximo, ético e transparente com o investidor
  • Atuar em conformidade com as normas da CVM, Ancord e B3


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Certificação Ancord (AAI) ou certificações equivalentes exigidas pelo mercado
  • Conhecimento em mercado financeiro e produtos de investimento
  • Perfil comercial e consultivo
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de relacionamento
  • Atualização constante sobre economia e finanças

title: Senior Finance Business Partner
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Finance Business Partner to support our rapidly growing Customer Service platform across multiple countries. This role sits at the intersection of finance and operations, acting as a strategic advisor to business leaders while ensuring strong financial governance, scalable processes, and disciplined cost management.


The ideal candidate brings deep Finance BP experience, thrives in fast-paced environments, and demonstrates strong business acumen — particularly within customer-centric or service-driven organizations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Finance Partnership: Partner closely with the multi-country Customer Service leadership team to drive financial planning, improve decision-making, and embed financial discipline into daily operations.
  • Financial Process Optimization: Design, implement, and continuously improve financial processes, policies, and controls. Provide expert guidance to support sustainable and compliant business growth.
  • Market Expansion Support: Lead financial readiness for launches in new countries or cities by establishing scalable frameworks, ensuring operational continuity, and proactively mitigating financial risks.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work in close partnership with Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Reporting, and Internal Controls teams to ensure regulatory compliance and alignment with corporate standards.
  • Budgeting & Forecasting Leadership: Own the annual budgeting cycle and rolling forecasts for the Customer Experience (CE) business. Build a robust budget management structure and partner with stakeholders to drive accountability and financial performance.
  • Advanced Financial Analysis: Develop a comprehensive financial analysis framework to evaluate business performance, identify risks and opportunities, and deliver actionable insights — with a strong focus on cost efficiency and operational productivity within customer service environments.
  • Data & Financial Digitalization: Contribute to the evolution of financial systems and digital tools by defining analytical and monitoring requirements that enhance visibility and decision support.


Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • Solid experience in Finance Business Partnering or similar strategic finance roles.
  • Proven exposure to multi-country or regional operations .
  • Strong business judgment with the ability to translate financial data into strategic recommendations.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders.
  • Advanced analytical capabilities and proficiency with financial and data analysis tools.
  • Highly adaptable, proactive, and comfortable operating in dynamic, high-growth environments.
  • Professional fluency in English.
  • Experience managing finance for customer service, contact centers, shared services, or operations-heavy businesses .
  • Background in multinational or high-growth technology, e-commerce, logistics, or platform companies.


Why Join Us

  • Scale with a high-growth global business: Play a key role in supporting rapidly expanding international operations.
  • True business exposure: Operate as a strategic partner with direct impact on operational and financial outcomes.
  • Broad finance scope: Gain hands-on experience across multiple finance disciplines while shaping scalable frameworks for the future.
  • High visibility: Collaborate with senior stakeholders and influence critical business decisions.

title: Especialista em materiais
description:
Especialista em Materiais (Inovação em Materiais Sustentáveis)


Você deseja conectar pesquisa em materiais sustentáveis à aplicação industrial em projetos de alto impacto?

Buscamos um profissional cuja missão será atuar de forma estratégica no desenvolvimento, na seleção e na caracterização de materiais, com foco em materiais biocompatíveis, celulose e polímeros biodegradáveis, assegurando a conexão entre a pesquisa laboratorial, o desenvolvimento de MVPs e a viabilidade de aplicação em escala produtiva. Será responsável por conduzir ensaios laboratoriais especializados, desenvolver e otimizar formulações e processos, além de apoiar a transição eficiente das soluções desenvolvidas em laboratório para ambientes piloto e industriais.

O Especialista em Materiais atuará em colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares, fornecedores e parceiros externos, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de soluções sustentáveis e inovadoras para embalagens e aplicações disruptivas. Terá papel ativo na análise crítica de dados, na elaboração de relatórios técnicos robustos e na proposição de melhorias técnicas, tecnológicas e de processos, fortalecendo a cultura de inovação da empresa. O conhecimento e a aplicação de normas técnicas e regulatórias relacionadas a materiais biocompatíveis e biodegradáveis serão considerados diferenciais relevantes para o desempenho da função.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver, selecionar e caracterizar materiais biocompatíveis e biodegradáveis, com foco em desempenho, qualidade e escalabilidade.
  • Conduzir ensaios laboratoriais avançados, garantindo rastreabilidade, análise crítica e confiabilidade dos dados gerados.
  • Atuar na interface entre desenvolvimento de materiais, processos produtivos e aplicação industrial, apoiando o escalonamento das soluções.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para integração dos materiais desenvolvidos em produtos finais e sistemas produtivos.
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos, pareceres e recomendações baseadas em dados experimentais e benchmarks tecnológicos.
  • Acompanhar tendências tecnológicas e de mercado relacionadas a materiais sustentáveis, propondo inovações e melhorias contínuas.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente a interação com fornecedores, parceiros e centros de pesquisa.


Conhecimentos e habilidades

  • Sólida experiência em rotinas laboratoriais e experimentação avançada em materiais.
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento e caracterização físico-química, mecânica e funcional de materiais.
  • Capacidade de análise crítica, organização de dados e comunicação técnica clara.
  • Atuação colaborativa em ambientes multidisciplinares e orientação para solução de problemas.
  • Inglês avançado (leitura, escrita e conversação).


Formação

  • Graduação e/ou pós-graduação em Engenharia de Materiais, Química, Engenharia Química ou áreas correlatas.


Local de atuação

  • Piracicaba – SP.


Somos uma empresa para todos: Respeitamos, Incluímos e Valorizamos.

title: US Immigration Law Firm Paralegal / Brazilian Attorney (Remote)
description:
About Colombo & Hurd, PL


Colombo & Hurd, PL is a nationally recognized boutique immigration law firm dedicated to representing professionals, investors, businesses, and families from across Latin America and around the world. Since our founding in 2006, we’ve grown to a global team of over 350, including more than 30 U.S.-based immigration attorneys.


Named the Top Immigration Law Firm in Central Florida by the Orlando Business Journal, we take pride in our mission to provide exceptional legal representation while advancing the cause of immigrants. Our commitment to excellence, innovation, and integrity defines who we are.


Position Overview:


We are looking for a licensed attorney in Brazil to join our team, and work closely with U.S.-based attorneys, as well as our paralegals in South America and the U.S., to manage complex U.S. immigration cases. Your expertise will be instrumental in guiding high potential individuals and businesses through the intricate U.S. immigration landscape. A successful candidate will have excellent writing, research and analytical skills to assume responsibility in an active and diverse immigration practice. The applicant must be fully bilingual in both English and Portuguese.


This role requires excellent communication skills both via email and orally. It is exceptionally important that we communicate with our clients in both a timely and effective manner.


Our workforce uses their own devices, ensuring flexibility in how our team operates remotely. A stable internet connection with a speed of over 25 Mbps is required.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Strategic Case Analysis: Dive deep into complex EB-2 National Interest Waiver and EB-1 Immigrant Visa cases, identifying opportunities and potential challenges.
  • Meticulous Legal Research: Conduct in-depth legal research to ensure compliance with U.S. immigration laws and regulations.
  • Persuasive Legal Writing: Craft compelling legal documents, including petitions, briefs, and memorandums, to advocate for your clients' interests.
  • Client Collaboration: Build strong relationships with clients, providing clear and concise information and solicitation of documentation throughout the immigration process.
  • Global Teamwork: Collaborate seamlessly with a diverse team of legal professionals across the globe to achieve optimal outcomes.


Qualifications:


  • Licensed Lawyer in Brazil
  • 3+ years of legal experience (preferred, not required)
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong research and analytical abilities
  • Meticulous attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • A passion for immigration law and a desire to make a positive impact


Application process:


  • (Colombo & Hurd:) Resume review
  • Request for Brief Video Introduction
  • Interview with Colombo & Hurd Team
  • (Colombo & Hurd:) Offer


Job Type: Fully Remote full-time position - standard business hours.


Join our Dynamic Team:


As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge cases, collaborate with top legal minds, and make a significant impact on the lives of our clients.


We seek professionals who embody our core values of Integrity, Excellence, Teamwork, Hard Work, and Open Communication.


Ready to Make Your Mark?


If you're a motivated and talented attorney seeking a challenging and rewarding opportunity, we encourage you to apply.

title: Head of Finance
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Head of Finance para integrar nosso time!


A posição será responsável pela área financeira da Rooftop, integrando as frentes de franqueadora, operação/backoffice e veículos de investimento (FIIs e SPEs), garantindo disciplina financeira, crescimento sustentável, eficiência de capital e tomada de decisão orientada por dados.


Nosso modelo de negócio demanda uma liderança financeira, capaz de transitar entre corporate finance, gestão operacional e investimentos estruturados.


Principais Responsabilidades:


Estratégia Financeira & Planejamento (Franqueadora + Operação)

  • Definir e implementar a estratégia financeira da Rooftop alinhada ao plano de crescimento;
  • Realizar o planejamento financeiro (budget, forecast e longo prazo);
  • Monitorar e controlar modelos financeiros para sustentabilidade dos franqueados;
  • Monitorar KPIs financeiros e operacionais (unit economics, payback, margem e TIR por imóvel, entre outros);
  • Apoiar decisões estratégicas como estrutura de royalties, fees, campanhas, eventos da franqueadora e incentivos.

Gestão Financeira da Operação

  • Supervisionar contabilidade terceirizada;
  • Estruturar e acompanhar as áreas de controladoria, tesouraria e FP&A;
  • Garantir acuracidade de relatórios financeiros e compliance;
  • Estruturar processos financeiros escaláveis conforme a rede cresce;
  • Implementar/Gerir dashboards e sistemas de controle (ERP, BI, DRE por imóvel, fluxo de caixa consolidado);
  • Gerenciar capital de giro e eficiência operacional.

Estruturação e Gestão de Veículos de Investimento (Fundo e Dívida)

  • Participar da estruturação de fundos e/ou veículos de investimento voltados à expansão da Rooftop;
  • Trabalhar na modelagem financeira de veículos (retorno esperado, riscos, alavancagem, estrutura de capital);
  • Trabalhar na modelagem financeira dos ativos, memorando de investimentos por imóvel, ata de investimento aprovada em comitê Investidor e inteligência Imobiliária;
  • Relacionamento com investidores, gestoras, bancos e financiadores;
  • Gerenciar covenants, relatórios para investidores e performance dos veículos;
  • Avaliar oportunidades de captação (equity, dívida, project finance, CRIs, etc.).

Expansão e M&A

  • Liderar e/ou apoiar due diligence financeira;
  • Apoiar na construção de valuation e monitoramento de drivers de valor para a companhia.

Governança e Tomada de Decisão

  • Participar de comitês financeiros e de investimentos.
  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico do CEO e COO;
  • Preparar materiais para conselho, acionistas e investidores.


Requisitos:


  • Formação superior completa  em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Modelagem financeira avançada (Excel, Power BI, ferramentas analíticas);
  • Conhecimento em contabilidade, controladoria e tesouraria;
  • 8+ anos de experiência em áreas financeiras relevantes , incluindo: Corporate Finance, FP&A, Investment Banking, Private Equity, Venture Capital, ou Finanças em instituições financeiras, gestoras, instituições de pagamento;
  • Experiência com liderança e gestão de times financeiros;
  • Comunicação clara com diferentes stakeholders (CEO, COO, investidores, franqueados, bancos e gestoras);
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões em ambientes de crescimento acelerado;
  • Perfil hands-on, com capacidade de atuar tanto no nível estratégico quanto na execução.


Diferenciais:


  • Pós-graduação, MBA, CFA ou cursos avançados em finanças;
  • Experiência com captação de recursos;
  • Experiência na gestão de veículos de investimento imobiliário e/ou Distressed Assets;
  • Vivência com operações multiunidades ou franquias.


O que você terá na Rooftop:


  • Papel importante em uma empresa em crescimento;
  • Exposição a operações, franchising e investimentos;
  • Oportunidade de contribuir para estrutura financeira e de capital da empresa;
  • Ambiente empreendedor e orientado a resultados.


Oferecemos:


Benefícios: Vale Refeição/Alimentação, Vale-Transporte, Auxílio Cultura & Educação, Assistência Médica, Seguro de Vida e Wellhub.

Localização: 100% presencial, na região da Berrini.

title: Analista de Infraestrutura (Cloud - OCI)
description:
• Projetar arquiteturas de cloud computing em OCI considerando requisitos técnicos, de negócios, compliance e segurança.
  • Implementar serviços de infraestrutura como IaaS, PaaS e SaaS em OCI, incluindo redes virtuais (VCN), instâncias de computação, armazenamento, banco de dados autônomo, entre outros.
  • Gerenciar identidade e acesso (IAM), políticas de segurança, criptografia e controle de vulnerabilidades nos recursos da OCI.
  • Automatizar processos de provisionamento, escalonamento e monitoramento com ferramentas como Terraform, Ansible, OCI Resource Manager e scripts em Python/Bash.
  • Monitorar ambientes de produção em tempo real utilizando Oracle Cloud Monitoring, Logging e Alarms.
  • Administrar ambientes multicloud híbridos, promovendo integração entre OCI e outras nuvens públicas ou privadas (Azure, AWS, GCP).
  • Gerenciar custos e otimização de consumo com Oracle Cost Analysis, criando planos de uso eficiente dos recursos em nuvem (Finops).
  • Participar de projetos de migração de workloads locais para OCI, aplicando boas práticas e frameworks como Oracle Cloud Adoption Framework.
